title: 鐵路道岔轉轍機~Railway point machines
focus: 轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈~Point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain
summary: 本課聚焦轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈。從轉轍力位移作功建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把馬達回路與接觸與鎖閉確認狀態機連成可驗證的介面，最後以轉轍維修服務影響整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain. Start with point-machine force–travel work to define physical or information boundaries, connect motor circuit and contact behaviour with state machine for lock confirmation as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through service impact of point maintenance. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用連桿幾何與力矩及障礙與中止試驗矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through linkage geometry and torque and obstruction and interruption test matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究轉轍力位移作功。原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。敏感度只改 F=4500 至 4950 N，輸出變為 913.846 J；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究連桿幾何與力矩：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate point-machine force–travel work. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. For sensitivity, change only F=4500 to 4950 N; the output becomes 913.846 J. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate linkage geometry and torque: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 轉轍力位移作功~Point-machine force–travel work
units.title: 轉轍力位移作功~Point-machine force–travel work
units.mechanism: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。~Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded.
units.verify: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「轉轍力位移作功」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For point-machine force–travel work, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。回到「轉轍力位移作功」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. Trace the input chain for point-machine force–travel work. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉~Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
units.practice: 只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「轉轍力位移作功」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for point-machine force–travel work, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 連桿幾何與力矩~Linkage geometry and torque
units.title: 連桿幾何與力矩~Linkage geometry and torque
units.mechanism: 本單元畫出馬達到尖軌的傳力路徑，隨連桿角度變化檢查有效力臂與輸出推力。力矩取決於力與轉軸的垂直力臂，不只取決於馬達功率。連桿角度改變會改變機械利益，接近死點時力與位移關係尤其敏感；外殼上的扭矩讀值也不一定等於尖軌端的實際推力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。~Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. Torque depends on force and perpendicular lever arm, not merely motor power. Linkage angle changes mechanical advantage, particularly near a dead centre where force-displacement relations become sensitive. Torque measured at the housing need not equal effective force at the switch blade. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.
units.verify: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。以「連桿幾何與力矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. For linkage geometry and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。回到「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩~A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.
units.practice: 只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「連桿幾何與力矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for linkage geometry and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 雙端行程差異~Travel mismatch between coupled ends
units.title: 雙端行程差異~Travel mismatch between coupled ends
units.mechanism: 本單元以雙致動教具觀察小速度差如何累積為位置差，將同步需求與機械柔度分開。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~Use coupled actuators on a teaching rig to observe small speed differences accumulating into displacement mismatch, separating synchronization from mechanical compliance. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。公式 y=(v1-v2)*t*1000，代入得 y=10 mm。邊界：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s. Formula y=(v1-v2)*t*1000 gives y=10 mm. Boundary: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立位移計同時量測兩個連接點，對照編碼器零點與連桿幾何，再比較低負載及偏載時的誤差斜率。以「雙端行程差異」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure both connection points simultaneously with independent displacement sensors, compare encoder zeros and linkage geometry, then compare drift slopes at low and uneven load. For travel mismatch between coupled ends, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。回到「雙端行程差異」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference. Trace the input chain for travel mismatch between coupled ends. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零~Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
units.practice: 只把動作時間 t 從 20 改成 22 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 10 變為 11 mm。先說明「雙端行程差異」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only motion time t from 20 to 22 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 10 to 11 mm. Explain the causal direction for travel mismatch between coupled ends, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 馬達回路與接觸~Motor circuit and contact behaviour
units.title: 馬達回路與接觸~Motor circuit and contact behaviour
units.mechanism: 本單元用隔離直流回路分析接點電阻與供電下降，避免將低電流直接解讀為機械負載低。電壓與電流的關係取決於完整回路阻抗，不能只看單一導體。簡化電阻模型能用來辨認分流、接觸與漏電的量級，但交流軌道電路還涉及頻率、相位與耦合；量到電壓存在並不等於接收端已可靠判定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。~Use an isolated DC circuit to examine contact resistance and supply drop, avoiding interpretation of low current as necessarily low mechanical load. Voltage-current behaviour depends on the entire circuit rather than one conductor. A resistance model helps reason about shunts, contacts and leakage, while AC track circuits also depend on frequency, phase and coupling. Voltage presence alone does not establish a valid receiver decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Formula y=V/R gives y=1.5 A. Boundary: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included.
units.verify: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。以「馬達回路與接觸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time. For motor circuit and contact behaviour, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。回到「馬達回路與接觸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Such experiments do not belong on an operating track. Trace the input chain for motor circuit and contact behaviour. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常~Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.
units.practice: 只把等效電阻 R 從 8 改成 8.8 ohm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.5 變為 1.36364 A。先說明「馬達回路與接觸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only equivalent resistance R from 8 to 8.8 ohm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.5 to 1.36364 A. Explain the causal direction for motor circuit and contact behaviour, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 等效持續發熱估算~Equivalent sustained heating estimate
units.title: 等效持續發熱估算~Equivalent sustained heating estimate
units.mechanism: 本單元把頻繁轉換的週期平均發熱視為等效持續功率，僅估穩態溫度並檢查外殼量測是否漏掉內部熱點。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.
units.verify: 同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。以「等效持續發熱估算」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes. For equivalent sustained heating estimate, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 環境感測器放在熱排氣中會把自身熱源誤當室溫升高，遮蔽熱點又會低估最大元件溫度。回到「等效持續發熱估算」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An ambient sensor in hot exhaust mistakes self-heating for room temperature rise, while hidden hotspots understate component maxima. Trace the input chain for equivalent sustained heating estimate. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱~A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.

units.title: 傳動磨耗履歷~Transmission-wear history
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤連接銷與齒輪間隙隨動作次數的變化，避免把短期磨合率當成全壽命磨耗率。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。~Track pin and gear clearance with movement count rather than treating short running-in wear as a lifetime wear rate. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：觀察磨耗深度 depth=0.6 mm；觀察循環數 cycles=30000 cycles；外推循環數 future=10000 cycles。公式 y=depth/cycles*future，代入得 y=0.2 mm。邊界：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: observed wear depth depth=0.6 mm; observed cycles cycles=30000 cycles; extrapolated cycles future=10000 cycles. Formula y=depth/cycles*future gives y=0.2 mm. Boundary: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.verify: 在相同位置重複量輪廓與累積負載，檢查分段斜率是否改變，再決定是否可外推。以「傳動磨耗履歷」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation. For transmission-wear history, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。回到「傳動磨耗履歷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. Trace the input chain for transmission-wear history. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變~The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
units.practice: 只把外推循環數 future 從 10000 改成 10001 cycles（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變為 0.20002 mm。先說明「傳動磨耗履歷」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only extrapolated cycles future from 10000 to 10001 cycles (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.2 to 0.20002 mm. Explain the causal direction for transmission-wear history, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 鎖閉確認狀態機~State machine for lock confirmation
units.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機~State machine for lock confirmation
units.mechanism: 本單元將行程完成、鎖閉與位置確認分成獨立條件，檢查任何單一訊號是否被錯當全部成立。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Separate completed travel, locking and position confirmation, checking whether any one signal is incorrectly treated as proof of all conditions. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「鎖閉確認狀態機」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For state machine for lock confirmation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「鎖閉確認狀態機」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for state machine for lock confirmation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 256 to 512 states. Explain the causal direction for state machine for lock confirmation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 動作與回授時間鏈~Motion and feedback timing chain
units.title: 動作與回授時間鏈~Motion and feedback timing chain
units.mechanism: 本單元比較命令、馬達啟動、行程結束與回授採用時刻，辨認機械延遲及介面延遲。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Compare command, motor start, end of travel and feedback adoption to distinguish mechanical delay from interface delay. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.verify: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「動作與回授時間鏈」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For motion and feedback timing chain, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「動作與回授時間鏈」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for motion and feedback timing chain. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for motion and feedback timing chain, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 障礙與中止試驗矩陣~Obstruction and interruption test matrix
units.title: 障礙與中止試驗矩陣~Obstruction and interruption test matrix
units.mechanism: 本單元只在隔離教具重播障礙與失電情境，確認測試覆蓋並保留安全中止後的狀態證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Replay obstruction and power-loss cases only on an isolated teaching rig, checking coverage and preserving state evidence after safe interruption. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「障礙與中止試驗矩陣」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For obstruction and interruption test matrix, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. units.anchor: 轉轍維修服務影響~Service impact of point maintenance
units.title: 轉轍維修服務影響~Service impact of point maintenance
units.mechanism: 本單元將故障頻率與修復等待分開，辨認備品、定位診斷或機械調整何者主導不可用時間。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Separate failure frequency from repair waiting to identify whether spares, diagnosis or mechanical adjustment dominates unavailable time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.verify: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「轉轍維修服務影響」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For service impact of point maintenance, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for service impact of point maintenance. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for service impact of point maintenance, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
